pathAssistantSteps.info: Confirm the kickoff date with the customer and check the target go-live date is realistic.
Capture requirements, integrations and stakeholders in Gathering Info Notes. You can't move to Implementation without them.
Record what was configured in Implementation Notes so QA knows what to check. Required before QA / Review.
If QA fails, move the onboarding back to Implementation. The rework is counted and the original stage dates are kept.
Confirm the customer is live and using the platform.
Run the post-launch review. The onboarding no longer counts towards your active workload.
